$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.check.haxe.design. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-HSS-ONE-FEATURE-ENOUGH
arms.note: one named character is already a scanner, so a lone quote test or a lone backslash test is reported

arms.name: M-HSS-READ-UNREQUIRED
arms.note: a loop that reads no character is reported for the numbers it compares

arms.name: M-HSS-STATE-FLAG-IGNORED
arms.note: a quote beside a flag the loop toggles is never reported

arms.name: M-HSS-STATE-DECLARED-IN-LOOP
arms.note: a flag declared inside the iteration counts as state carried between characters

arms.name: M-HSS-DEPTH-IGNORED
arms.find: return paired && depth ? 'compares characters with a bracket pair and counts its depth in a variable' : null;
arms.note: a bracket pair beside a depth counter is never reported

arms.name: M-HSS-DEPTH-ONE-WAY
arms.note: a counter that only grows, which is a position, counts as a depth

arms.name: M-HSS-ALLOW-IGNORED
arms.note: a path under an allow key is scanned like any other

arms.name: M-HSS-COMPARED-ONLY-STRING
arms.note: a one-character string only emitted or stored names a character like a compared one

arms.name: M-HSS-COMPARED-ONLY-NUMBER
arms.note: a number only assigned names a character like a compared one

arms.name: M-HSS-CASE-PATTERN-IGNORED
arms.find: for (kind in [shape.plainCasePatternKind, shape.orPatternKind]) if (kind != null) kind
arms.note: a case value is not an operand of a comparison, so a switch over character codes names nothing

arms.name: M-HSS-CODE-FIELD
arms.note: a misspelt field name reads no character through a `.code`

arms.name: M-HSS-CODE-PASSTHROUGH
arms.note: the literal under a compared `.code` is no longer a compared operand

arms.name: M-HSS-PREDECR-KIND
arms.note: a misspelt kind name leaves a prefix decrement unseen

arms.name: M-HSS-POSTDECR-KIND
arms.note: a misspelt kind name leaves a postfix decrement unseen

arms.name: M-HSS-SUB-ASSIGN-KIND
arms.note: a misspelt kind name leaves `d -= 1` unseen

arms.name: M-HSS-ADD-ASSIGN-ONE
arms.note: `d += 1` no longer counts as stepping up

arms.name: M-HSS-OPENERS-LITERAL
arms.note: a spelled `/*` or `//` names no comment opener

arms.name: M-HSS-DIRECTIVES-LITERAL
arms.note: a spelled `#if` names no directive

arms.name: M-HSS-SLASH-STAR
arms.note: a compared `/` beside a compared `*` names no comment opener

arms.name: M-HSS-DOUBLE-SLASH
arms.note: two compared `/` name no comment opener
